definitions.ask: Should this tale also make the screencast keycast overlay show ⇧ on chorded letters, so ⌃⇧X stops recording as ⌃X?
definitions.why: The ambiguity hid which chord was pressed in this bug's screencast; the fix is tiny

choices.label: Fix the Hammerspoon keycast label in chezmoi plus its busted spec; future screencasts show ⌃⇧X
Leave the overlay as is; ⌃⇧X and ⌃X keep rendering the same in screencasts and keystroke tracks
